title: Squirrel holding a balloon
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d="M62 18 Q66 35 58 50 Q54 58 50 62" fill="none" stroke="#c8e6ff" stroke-width="1.6"/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="16" rx="11" ry="13" fill="#ff5f7e"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="11" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#ffb3c2"/>
  <path d="M62 28 L66 28 L64 32 Z" fill="#e03a5c"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M30 66 Q14 62 14 46 Q14 32 28 34 Q22 46 30 54 Q36 58 34 64 Z" fill="#e07b2f"/>
  <path d="M27 62 Q18 58 18 46 Q18 37 26 38 Q22 48 28 54 Q32 57 31 61 Z" fill="#ffb371"/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="68" rx="17" ry="18" fill="#d9792e"/>
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="72" rx="11" ry="12" fill="#ffcf99"/>
  <!-- Back leg -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="84" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#b8621f"/>
  <!-- Foot -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="88" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#ffd9a8"/>
  <!-- Front leg -->
  <ellipse cx="54" cy="84" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#c96d26"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="88" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#ffd9a8"/>
  <!-- Arm holding string -->
  <path d="M52 62 Q58 58 60 54" fill="none" stroke="#c96d26" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="53" r="4.5" fill="#ffcf99"/>
  <!-- Other arm -->
  <path d="M36 60 Q30 60 28 56" fill="none" stroke="#b8621f" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="55" r="4.5" fill="#ffcf99"/>
  <!-- Belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="68" rx="7" ry="9" fill="#ffe9cc"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="36" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#d9792e"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="36" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#d9792e"/>
  <ellipse cx="39" cy="37" rx="2" ry="3.5" fill="#ffb371"/>
  <ellipse cx="51" cy="37" rx="2" ry="3.5" fill="#ffb371"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="46" r="14" fill="#e88a3a"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb371"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="52" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb371"/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="53" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#ffd9a8"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="44" r="2.6" fill="#3a1e08"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="2.6" fill="#3a1e08"/>
  <circle cx="41" cy="43" r="1" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <circle cx="51" cy="43" r="1" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="50" r="2" fill="#8a3d12"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M45 52 Q42 55 40 53 M45 52 Q48 55 50 53" fill="none" stroke="#8a3d12" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Teeth -->
  <rect x="43" y="55" width="4" height="3" rx="1" fill="#fff4e0"/>
  <!-- Tiny acorn accent on belly? no. done -->
</svg>
